Ctrack UK Limited.main_product: Fleet management, GPS vehicle tracking, and AI video telematics platform
Ctrack UK Limited.reason: Ctrack is a specialist provider dedicated to fleet telematics, real-time vehicle tracking, and AI-powered driver safety and video management solutions. It recently absorbed Inseego's UK fleet management division, cementing its focus on this core product suite.

PIN IoT Ltd.main_product: Digital skip and vehicle tracking software for the waste and recycling industry
PIN IoT Ltd.reason: The company's primary focus is container and skip tracking specifically tailored for waste management operations, with vehicle tracking acting as an integrated module within this specialized asset tracking platform rather than a standalone, horizontal connected-fleet solution.

Matrix IQ Ltd.main_product: Connected fleet and asset telematics platform
Matrix IQ Ltd.reason: Matrix iQ (formerly Matrix Telematics) specializes primarily in providing an intelligent fleet management and vehicle telematics platform, featuring real-time GPS tracking, AI dash cams (Cam iQ), driver behavior monitoring, and aggregated telematics data analytics as its primary business and revenue source.

Key Telematics Ltd.main_product: white-label telematics and asset tracking platform
Key Telematics Ltd.reason: Key Telematics is a specialized Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company whose main offering and entire business model center around providing a white-labeled, hardware-agnostic vehicle telematics and asset tracking platform.

REM Trading LTD.main_product: GPS fleet tracking and telematics software (GPSLive)
REM Trading LTD.reason: REM Trading LTD (brand Rewire Security) develops and delivers GPS vehicle tracking devices, video telematics (connected 4G dashcams), and the cloud-based fleet tracking platform GPSLive as its main offering for businesses and personal vehicle security.
